summary: Iteration 4 (IberoAcademy): tested the two new features — one-click OTEC/SENCE course report and attendance certificates for finalized live classes. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass (test_iteration4.py). Covered: GET /api/courses/{id}/report returns {course, generated_at, rows[], summary{students,approved,live_classes}} with student rows containing days_attended, total_minutes, live_attended/total, modules_done/total, modules_avg_nota, final_nota, overall_nota, status (Aprobado/En curso); staff_only enforced (403 for student, 401 unauth, 404 unknown course); counts verified (student A attended 1/2 live classes, student B 0/2). POST /api/live-classes/{id}/certificate: 404 when user has no attendance, 400 when class not finalizada, idempotent repeat returns the same code (prefix 'A'). GET /api/attendance-certificates/{code}: owner 200, other student 403, staff 200; response includes student_name, class_title, platform (Microsoft Teams/Google Meet), start/end/joined/duration_min, otec_name. GET /api/public/verify-attendance/{code} works with no auth, returns valid=true and otec_name, user_id intentionally omitted (no leak), 404 for invalid code. Regression: GET /api/live-classes returns correct status (finalizada/programada) and the student 'attended' boolean. Frontend: minted admin+student JWTs and stored to localStorage['otec_token']. /cursos/:id/editar → tab 'Reporte OTEC' (tab-report) opens, course-report-row rendered, course-report-export triggers CSV download (filename reporte_otec_I4UI985192_2026-10-02.csv). /clases as student shows live-class-certificate-<id> button only for the finalized attended class; clicking navigates to /certificado-asistencia/<code> with student name, class title ('TEST_i4ui_finished'), platform ('Microsoft Teams'), duration (60 min), attendance-cert-qr and 'Imprimir / Guardar PDF' button rendered. /verificar-asistencia/<code> (no auth) shows verify-attendance-valid + 'Asistencia verificada'; /verificar-asistencia/NOPE999 shows verify-attendance-invalid + 'Certificado no válido'. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: attendance_cert_data constructs datetime.fromisoformat on c['start_at']/'end_at' without defensive handling — if a legacy class row has a naive datetime (no tz), the diff still works but class_status would already have forced tzinfo elsewhere; consider centralizing a parse_iso() helper.

course_report iterates enrollments and does per-user find for user, sessions, live_attendance.count_documents — N+1 pattern. For a course with hundreds of students this will be slow. Consider aggregating in a single pipeline or batching users/sessions.

course_report() live_pct is rounded to int percentage but modules_avg_nota/final_nota/overall_nota are notas (1–7) coming from course_grades — the CSV/table mixes units; make sure UI/CSV header labels disambiguate 'Prom. mód.' vs 'Clases %' (currently 'Clases' column shows x/y, not %).

attendance_certificate uses secrets.token_hex(5).upper() -> 10 hex chars with 'A' prefix (11 chars); collision space ~10^12, OK but note cert_code field has no unique index in Mongo. Add a unique partial index on live_attendance.cert_code to defend against racy double-insert should the endpoint ever be parallelized.

verify_attendance leaks nothing user-identifying (user_id popped) but still returns full student_name + rut; this is public! Any valid code lookup reveals a Chilean RUT. Consider masking RUT in the public endpoint (e.g., '11.111.***-K') or omitting entirely — the UI only displays the student name.
live_attendance.find_one for cert_code uses rec['cert_code'] without an index; add index on live_attendance.cert_code for scalability.
class_status() tz handling: forcing t.tzinfo on naive datetimes assumes the server's tz is what the stored naive datetimes intended; prefer storing UTC consistently and raising on naive at ingestion.
